stills.prompt: Wide frontal view, at standing eye level, down a long monumental chamber of worn charcoal stone toward its far end wall. The end wall is solid except for one narrow, person-width vertical passage cut cleanly through it just right of centre, its edges sharp and squared; faint cool light falls through it from beyond. The floor is dark polished stone, nearly black, with a soft reflection. Plain stone pillars recede on both sides. The chamber is empty: nothing stands on the floor. Low-key interior: a monumental near-black chamber of worn charcoal stone with almost no ambient light. One cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light rakes in from high on the left. No sunlight, no warm sandstone, no glow. Photorealistic vertical cinematic film still, restrained, natural film grain.

A single massive monolithic block of worn charcoal stone, squared with chamfered edges, chisel marks and fine cracks, standing upright, twice the height of a person, seen straight on at standing eye level from about fifteen metres away. A small round aged-gold (#C6A94F) survey benchmark disc is set flush into its face. Lit only by one cool bone-white (#F5F2EB) light from high left. Isolated against a flat, even, mid-grey studio backdrop with no shadow on the backdrop and no floor visible, so it can be cut out cleanly. Photorealistic, natural film grain.
